data.title: Vitalia Residences
data.about:
Vitalia Palm Jumeirah Residences by Pinnacle Developers is an ultra-luxury project on the East Crescent of Palm Jumeirah available for an unbeatable payment plan. The 10-story building offers an exclusive waterfront lifestyle with spacious, contemporary 2 to 4-bedroom duplexes and 4-bedroom penthouses. ranging from 1,939 sq. ft. to 4,488 sq. ft. Every unit at Vitalia Residences has a private pool and it offers open sea views, providing residents with unparalleled tranquility and luxury.

Vitalia Residences duplexes and penthouses are designed with high-end amenities for those seeking a refined, serene lifestyle. Facilities include a gym, kids' play area, lush green spaces, and retail outlets, ensuring every need is met within this luxury Vitalia Residences Palm Jumeirah community.

With a prime location and thoughtful Vitalia Residences floor plan, this project redefines modern living in Dubai, making it the ultimate choice for peaceful, luxury living.

characteristics_module.title: Discover Palm Jumeirah’s Hidden Gem: Vitalia Residences
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusive Waterfront Lifestyle – Nestled on the iconic Palm Jumeirah, Vitalia by Pinnacle AKS Real Estate Development redefines serene, modern living.
  • Spacious & Thoughtfully Designed – Each Vitalia Residences apartment and penthouse features spacious interiors, elegant finishes, and private pools.
  • Convenience Meets Exclusivity – Strategically located with easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road, residents enjoy both connectivity and tranquility.
  • Luxury Amenities for Every Need – Vitalia Residences amenities include a state-of-the-art gym, lush green areas, parks, and kids' play zones.
  • Options for Every Lifestyle – Choose from versatile floor plans, including 2-bedroom apartments, 3-bedroom layouts, 4-bedroom duplexes, and exclusive penthouses.
  • Unmatched Payment Plan – A market-leading payment plan exclusive to this project with post handover option.

location_tile.title: Iconic Living on Dubai's Most Coveted Island
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The Vitalia Palm Jumeirah Residences, developed by Pinnacle, offers a prime location on Dubai’s iconic Palm Jumeirah. This man-made island ensures seamless access to Dubai’s significant areas via Sheikh Zayed Road (E11). Vitalia Residences' residents enjoy exclusivity and connectivity, making it ideal for a luxurious yet accessible lifestyle.

Vitalia Residences will be ideally situated in the prestigious Palm Jumeirah area, surrounded by luxury hotels and fine dining options. Residents will enjoy close proximity to numerous entertainment venues, including Aquaventure Waterpark and Nakheel Mall.
